# ASTC reference decoder

Unmodified decompressor sources from [Arm astc-encoder](https://github.com/ARM-software/astc-encoder), revision `baff485b0ff36d2f95d28961605106502c653966`, under Apache-2.0. Built only by the ASTC rewrite regression, with `ASTCENC_DECOMPRESS_ONLY`; the apps do not link this decoder. The production rewrite does not call it.
